boundary_rows.N_one: static process with no selected edge
boundary_rows.N_three: the zero-diagonal centered block has dimension zero
boundary_rows.N_two: the sole difference is multiplied by 1-2eta; eta=1/2 reaches consensus in one step
boundary_rows.consensus_line: every update fixes constant vectors for all eta
boundary_rows.eta_one: each update is a transposition and disagreement energy is constant
boundary_rows.eta_zero: identity second-moment transfer; all present blocks merge into eigenvalue 1 with total multiplicity N(N-1)/2

collision_boundary.C183: random-transposition permutation-chain spectrum; it meets only the eta=1 boundary
collision_boundary.C203: deterministic signed-Laplacian consensus, not iid pair-matrix products
collision_boundary.C312: state-dependent Hegselmann--Krause finite termination, not uniform random-edge relaxation
collision_boundary.C322: continuous-angle Kac collision spectrum, not pairwise coordinate averaging

model.edge_law: one unordered pair is selected independently and uniformly at each step
model.state: x in R^N with N>=2; N=1 is separately static

nonclaims: No literature-priority claim is made for randomized gossip or for the complete-graph second-moment decomposition.
The moment-transfer eigenvalues are source relaxation data, not target zeros or an orbit zeta.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, Hilbert--Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

references.role: original randomized-gossip and distributed-averaging source owner

theorem_contract.boundaries: N=1,2,3 and eta=0,1 are separate; eta=1 is random transposition rather than consensus
theorem_contract.consensus: for 0<eta<1 the mean-square law is sharp and implies almost-sure consensus for every initial vector
theorem_contract.decomposition: Sym^2(1-perp) splits orthogonally into explicit scalar, standard, and zero-diagonal centered blocks
theorem_contract.evolution: the full disagreement second moment and statistical covariance are exact at every time
theorem_contract.mean: the sample mean is pathwise invariant and E[y_t]=(1-2eta/(N-1))^t y_0
theorem_contract.spectrum: the three orthogonal blocks are invariant for all eta; for eta>0 every present nonzero block is a distinct full eigenspace with the stated eigenvalue and multiplicity, while eta=0 is one identity eigenspace of total multiplicity N(N-1)/2
theorem_contract.tail_domain: the normalized tail bound requires epsilon>0 and nonzero initial disagreement; consensus-line data are fixed pathwise
